The '''''Gozanti''-class cruiser''', also known as the '''''Gozanti''-class armored cruiser''', '''''Gozanti''-class armed transport''', or simply the '''Gozanti Cruiser''', was a slow but powerful independent [[Transport/Legends|transport]] designed by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="SOTG07" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Gozanti_Cruiser.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Starboard view]]
Powerful and reliable,<ref name="AOR CRB" /> the Gozanti was described as a flying fortress,<ref name="SOTG07" /> being built for durability and firepower over cargo capacity and speed.<ref name="FLY" />

Designed by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], few were actually built by CEC; instead, the design was leased to numerous other companies for construction,<ref name="SOTG07" /> notably [[Gallofree Yards, Inc./Legends|Gallofree Yards, Inc.]]<ref name="FLY" />

First produced during the Old Republic, the ship was made intentionally slow to prove to Republic Inspectors that the ship couldn't be used as a pirate vessel. And, though the ship was used by many independent organizations, including [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and a number of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], it was never used in a direct act of piracy.<ref name="SOTG07" />

With difficulty, better performance could be coaxed out of the vessel, as many were refurbished into capable warships by the resource strapped [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] - with Rebellion engineers bringing many up to a level that allowed them to operate with respectable effectiveness in modern combat. Ultimately, the Rebellion deployed Gozantis as escort vessels, in line with their original design, and as capital ships in times of desperate need.<ref name="AOR CRB" /> 

The Imperial version of the ship allows for the transport of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE]] fighters, [[All Terrain Defense Pod/Legends|AT-DP]] walkers, and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] between fleet elements and planetary garrisons. It can carry up to four TIEs mounted beneath its wings and can serve as a dropship for troopers and walkers in active battle zones.<ref name=":0" />

Well-armored, these vessels were notoriously difficult to board, much to the consternation of many a space [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], and were equipped with unusually heavy armor and hull bracing.<ref name="SOTG07" /> Armed with heavy retractable weaponry<ref name="FLY" /> including four [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], two [[quad laser cannon]] turrets and a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]], the Gozanti was more than a match for casual pirates using second rate tech and retrofitted [[transport]]s.<ref name="SOTG07" />

Primarily used by [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]], militaries and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to defend cargo vessels from [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], a few were used as diplomatic vessels, and were popular choices for mobile command centers. When a Gozanti did fall into the hands of a criminal, they were inevitably turned into prison ships and or highly secure personal transports on account of their speed.<ref name="SOTG07" />

The cruisers could carry twelve passengers and the crew consisted of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], co-pilot, communications/sensor operator, two loadmasters, and six [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]].<ref name="AOR CRB" />

==History==
First produced during the [[Galactic Republic]], the design fell out of favor with shipyards during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]], though, soon after the post-[[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]] collapse of Imperial central authority, the demand for heavily armed and armored civilian ships surged, and the Gozanti once more was rushed back into production to enjoy new popularity.<ref name="SOTG07" />

The ''[[Krayt's Honor/Legends|Krayt's Honor]]'' was a well-known Gozanti Cruiser noted for its use by freelancers protecting various merchants who were otherwise harassed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Years prior to the advent of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it could be seen in the space port of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="DB" /><ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

During the Clone Wars, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] militarized Gozanti cruisers and used them as support ships. These vessels were painted in Separatist colors. Several ships served in the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|super tactical droid]] [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O]].<ref name="SW" /> The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate modified Gozantis and used them as [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].<ref name="E" /> After the [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|takeover]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] by the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], both Separatist and Black Sun Gozantis were seen using the city of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]] as a stopover point.<ref name="TL">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref> 

Following the rise of the Galactic Empire, the Gozanti-class underwent a standardized naval refitting that enabled it to serve as a dedicated transport platform for Imperial forces and to support the deployment of Imperial personnel and vehicles.<ref name=":0">[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|''Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars Insider 63|''Star Wars Insider'' 63]] incorrectly identifies the Gozanti Cruiser and the [[Taylander shuttle/Legends|Taylander shuttle]] as "Brocklander ships." [[Star Wars Insider 65|''Star Wars Insider'' 65]] corrects the mistake, stating that "Brocklander" was only a nickname used during production.
